title: Three-Way Quickselect
statement:
Implement randomized quickselect with a three-way partition to find the kth smallest element. Count equal elements separately in the ranking.

Input
n k, followed by n integers.

Output
Print the 1-based kth smallest value.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ k ≤ n.
